unit: One seed mean across the same five fixed station folds
test: Two-sided exact sign enumeration of Wilcoxon signed ranks, zero differences omitted; requires symmetric paired-difference distribution for signed-rank location interpretation
confidence_intervals: Unadjusted paired t intervals for seed-mean differences, conditional on fixed data, folds and model settings; not simultaneous or population-station intervals
null_interpretation: Failure to reject is not equivalence or proof of no effect; no equivalence margin was prespecified
scope: 15 stochastic replications of the same Delhi year; no additional city, station or field measurement
